limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses in vitro 3D culture models and mouse tumor tissues; direct in vivo manipulation of tissue stiffness was not performed.
The causal chain from matrix stiffness to malignant transformation is inferred from correlations and pharmacological/genetic perturbations; long-term in vivo tumorigenesis assays are lacking.
The role of other mechanosensitive pathways beyond ERK and Rho was not explored.
The study focuses on mammary epithelial cells and fibroblasts; generalizability to other cell types is not established.
The force threshold for integrin aggregation and FA assembly was demonstrated using exogenous shear; endogenous force dynamics in 3D may differ.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
